Messages.Author: Name
Messages.Body:
Caliban bleeds
Krassimir blocks and plays Internal Recursion for the presence ability:
"This blocking vampire can end combat as a strike during the resulting
combat. If he or she does so and the acting minion is an ally or a younger
vampire, this blocking vampire untaps."
Caliban strikes hands
Krassimir ends combat
Caliban plays Telepathic Tracking at superior: "Only usable when both
combatants are still ready and combat is about to end (with no uncanceled
press to continue). Combat does not end; another round starts."

Since Internal Recursion just says "can end combat as a strike during the
resulting combat" can Krassimir again end combat in the next round?

Or is this an example of "During X do Y" so that Krassimir can only once end
combat.

Thanks!

NW

The former.
Sure.
